data.criteria: Signed contract; SOW deliverables, acceptance criteria, billing milestones and named AWB team agreed; Sept-2027 go-live confirmed in writing.
Charter states objectives, scope, budget incl. contingency, governance, key risks; Sponsor signs.
All staff briefed on why, timeline and the 3 rules; Q&A captured. Held 25-Sep-2026.
All 5 Process Owners + backups named with ≥50% time allocation approved by their managers; RACI and decision matrix approved.
Process Owners oriented on templates; mapping workshop calendar issued per domain.
Top 5–7 workflows mapped per domain and validated; Pain Point Log and Shadow IT Register complete.
Dossier v1 has all 5 components; SteerCo agrees remaining gaps and the Nov–Dec cleansing priorities.
Dossier complete with all 5 components; sent to AWB ≥ 5 working days before BRD.
Checklist deliverables 1–8 done; cleansing first-pass signed by Dept. Heads; BRD schedule & attendance confirmed.
Kickoff held; project plan, governance and communication channels agreed with AWB.
BRD reviewed in 2 rounds; every requirement traced to a process; gaps classified (config / custom / out of scope); signed by POs and SteerCo.
Wave 1 processes demonstrated end to end on PHI data; open issues logged and owned.
All Wave 1+2 config complete; approved CRs only after this date; CRP2 accepted.
All test cases executed; no open Severity 1/2 defects; integrations pass.
≥95% UAT scripts passed; no open Sev 1, Sev 2 with agreed workaround; Mock 2 data reconciled; POs sign.
Go-No-Go checklist all green or accepted; Mock 3 timed within cutover window; users trained; support ready.
Production live; opening balances loaded; users transacting.
September books closed in Odoo within agreed close calendar; TB reconciled.
Hypercare exit criteria met: no Sev 1, backlog agreed, BAU support model live, documentation handed over.
